description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M, current <150M SOTA) with two capacity cuts: embedding_dim 144 -> 96, d_v 24 -> 16. H*d_v = 96 = E preserved, so out_proj input/output dims still match. Expected ~84.95M params (-15.7M vs exp696): v_lut -0.79M/layer, out_proj -1.57M/layer, tok_emb_E -1.57M. residual_lut, qk_lut, emb_resid_lut, unembedder unchanged. Tests whether emb_resid_lut SOTA still holds at a smaller param budget. Comparison anchors: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M, exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M, exp684=1.4262 @ 140M.
